description: Defines classes and interfaces for creating and managing HTTP authentication handlers, including factory classes for different schemes like Basic, Digest, NTLM, and Negotiate. Contains class declarations, method signatures, and factory registration mechanisms.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerFactory
classes.description: Abstract factory interface for creating HttpAuthHandler objects based on authentication challenges.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerRegistryFactory
classes.description: Dispatches creation requests to specific factories based on the authentication scheme.

methods.name: CreateAuthHandler
methods.description: Creates an HttpAuthHandler based on the challenge challenge token, target, SSL info, and other parameters.

methods.name: CreateAuthHandlerFromString
methods.description: Creates an HttpAuthHandler from a challenge string by tokenizing and calling CreateAuthHandler.

methods.name: CreatePreemptiveAuthHandlerFromString
methods.description: Creates a preemptive HttpAuthHandler from a challenge string.

methods.name: CreateDefault
methods.description: Creates a default registry factory supporting common schemes like Basic, Digest, NTLM, and Negotiate.

methods.name: SetHttpAuthPreferences
methods.description: Sets the HTTP authentication preferences for the factory.

methods.name: RegisterSchemeFactory
methods.description: Registers a factory for a specific authentication scheme.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a registry factory with optional GSSAPI or Kerberos support.

methods.name: GetSchemeFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the factory associated with a specific scheme.

methods.name: IsSchemeAllowedForTesting
methods.description: Checks if a scheme is allowed for all origins based on policy.
